message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The fact: defendant Wang2 gave cash 20,000 RMB to Wang3, the then director of health bureau, to seek job promotion (position adjustment). This is bribery: giving money to a public official to obtain a favorable action (position adjustment). The defendant is the briber (giving bribe). The crime is "行贿" (bribery). In examples, they label "行贿" for giving bribe to public officials. For example earlier: "上林县人民检察院指控...吴某...行贿". So answer: [罪名]行贿<eoa>. Possibly also "受贿" is for the official receiving, but the defendant is the briber. So just 行贿.

Thus final answer: [罪名]行贿<eoa>
